title: Studio gate reply
description: video/<slug>/studio/replies/<gateId>.json. Written once by the studio (or a test) to answer the gate of the same gateId.

decision.description: "approve" approves the stage; the other decisions per stage are defined by the web studio.

notes.description: The user's comments; may be empty.

changes.description: The fields the user edited in the studio, so Claude knows what to re-read.
